description: This line plot illustrates how the minimum FDE20 (minFDE20, in meters) varies with the Ratio parameter across four different model tuning methods: Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64. The x-axis, labeled "Ratio," spans from 0 to 1.0 in a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "minFDE20 (m)", ranges from 18 to 23 meters in a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The "Head Tuning" method is represented by a blue line with circular markers, which shows a consistent downward trend, starting at approximately 20.5 meters at a Ratio of 0 and decreasing to about 18.0 meters at a Ratio of 1.0. The "FT" method is shown as a green line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 22.3 meters at Ratio 0, dipping to about 21.8 meters at Ratio 0.2, rising slightly to around 22.0 meters at Ratio 0.4, then remaining relatively flat until Ratio 0.8 before increasing to about 21.0 meters at Ratio 1.0. The "LoRA 16" method is depicted by a red line with circular markers, starting at approximately 23.0 meters at Ratio 0, remaining nearly constant at around 23.0 meters until Ratio 0.4, then gradually declining to about 22.0 meters at Ratio 1.0. The "LoRA 64" method is represented by a purple line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 23.0 meters at Ratio 0, showing a slight decline to about 22.5 meters at Ratio 0.2, then remaining relatively stable around 22.2 to 22.5 meters until Ratio 1.0.
